components.name: TradingPage
components.description: Full trading interface: chart, orderbook, order entry, and positions in one responsive page.

variants.description: Render the full trading page for one symbol.
tips: tradingViewConfig comes from the chart setup copied from the DEX template.

variants.description: Drive the symbol from the route and keep the URL in sync.
tips: onSymbolChange receives the full symbol object, not a string.

components.stylingNotes: TradingPage is responsive and fills its container. Size the parent, not the page.
commonMistakes: Omitting tradingViewConfig — it is required by TradingPageProps.

components.name: OrderBook
components.description: Live orderbook for one symbol, with optional trades alongside it.

tips: OrderBookWidget reads live data from the SDK providers.

variants.description: Size the orderbook and add a class for layout.
Orderbook and recent trades in a single widget.
tips: Use the split widgets when the orderbook and trades need separate layouts.

components.stylingNotes: The widgets inherit the app theme. Use className for the outer container.
commonMistakes: Passing a display pair such as BTC/USD instead of PERP_BTC_USDC.

components.name: OrderEntryWidget
components.description: Self-contained order entry form for a single symbol.

variants.description: Render the order form for one symbol.
tips: symbol is required and must be an Orderly symbol.

variants.description: Switch symbols without remounting the parent page.
tips: Changing symbol updates the form in place; no key or remount needed.

variants.description: Hide optional sections and keep a ref to the container.
tips: disableFeatures removes UI sections, not the underlying order logic.

components.stylingNotes: The widget is unstyled at the container level. Size it with the parent.
commonMistakes: Passing a display pair such as BTC/USD instead of PERP_BTC_USDC.

components.name: OrderEntry
components.description: Headless order entry: the presentational form plus the script/hook that supplies its state.

variants.description: Use the script hook and spread its result into the presentational form.
tips: OrderEntry takes the script return as props; OrderEntryWidget wraps both.

variants.description: Customize the form while keeping the SDK script in control.
tips: Use OrderEntryWidget unless you need to replace individual form sections.

variants.description: Build a fully custom form with useOrderEntry and submit the order yourself.
tips: setValue is the single-field setter; setValues merges multiple fields.

components.stylingNotes: The headless form is fully yours; use the SDK UI primitives if you want matching styles.
commonMistakes: Reading submitOrder/orderState — the hook returns submit and metaState.

components.name: PositionsWidget
components.description: Open positions table with live PnL and filtering.

variants.description: Render the positions table for the current account.
tips: The widget reads positions from the SDK providers.

variants.description: Filter to one symbol and react when the user selects another.
tips: onSymbolChange receives the full symbol object.

variants.description: Include pending orders, keep sort preferences, and use a custom container.
tips: includedPendingOrder shows orders that will open or change a position.

components.stylingNotes: The table inherits the app theme. Use the parent container for borders and padding.
commonMistakes: Importing Positions from @orderly.network/ui-positions — the export is PositionsWidget.
Calling usePositionClose without a position and order payload.

components.name: WalletConnectorWidget
components.description: Wallet connection button and modal, plus the hooks for connection state.

variants.description: Drop the connector into a header or nav.
tips: WalletConnectorWidget opens the SDK connect modal.

variants.description: Show the connected address and a disconnect action.
tips: useWalletConnector returns a flat object; wallet is WalletState | null.

variants.description: Expose chain switching alongside the connector.
tips: setChain accepts a string or numeric chain id.

components.stylingNotes: The connector inherits the app theme. Wrap it in your own nav styles.
commonMistakes: Importing useAccountInfo and destructuring isConnected/network — it returns an SWR response.
Importing from @orderly.network/react, which is the legacy 1.x package.
